name: Curse of Opulence
oracle_text:
Enchant player
Whenever enchanted player is attacked, create a Gold token. Each opponent attacking that player does the same. (A Gold token is an artifact with "Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")
blocked_sentences: Whenever enchanted player is attacked, create a Gold token. Each opponent attacking that player does the same.

needs.what: a colorless Gold artifact token with "Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color." (no {T} in the cost), created by each recipient under their own control
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has no Gold token; the closest is treasure_token, whose ability is "{T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of any color." -- it has a tap in its cost and the Treasure subtype, so it is a different token (can't be used while tapped, counts for Treasure synergies)

needs.what: a player set for for_each_player meaning "each opponent (of the Curse's controller) who is attacking the enchanted player this combat", so each of them creates a Gold token under their own control alongside the Curse's controller
needs.why_existing_wont_do: for_each_player takes `players` (e.g. each_opponent), and the trigger side is covered by `creatures_attack_player` with `defending: enchanted_player`, but no player spec found in reference filters opponents down to those with a creature attacking the enchanted player; each_opponent would also give tokens to non-attacking opponents and to the enchanted player. Secondary to the token gap; unverified whether a select_players spec already exists for this
